newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Network General cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Network General cut.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist cut its rating on shares of Network General Corp to hold from buy and cut its estimate for fiscal 1998, ending March 31, 1998.
-- cut the earnings forecast to $0.68 a share on sales of $250.7 million from $1.21 a share on sales of $320.5 million.
-- follows a company announcement that earnings for Q1 of fiscal 1998 would range between $0.14 and $0.16 a share.
-- said company now believes revenue growth will range from five to 10 percent, down from a previous 33 percent.
-- Hambrecht revised its operating margins down to about 17 percent from a previous 25 percent.
